summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in displaying analytics metrics, specifically regarding traffic calculation. It was decided that total traffic should be shown as non-unique counts (not unique users), as ROTs and VAC are calculated from the overall traffic.

Regarding reach, a necessary adjustment was identified: the upper editor block needs to display reach relative to full, unrestricted traffic, both by frame and by demographics. Currently, only demographics influence reach.

Finally, it was agreed that initial features can be released on Monday, with metric lists being handled as a separate, second phase release.
decisions: Total traffic metrics must display non-unique counts (not unique users).
Reach calculation in the upper editor block needs to show data relative to full, unrestricted traffic for both frames and demographics.
Initial features can be released on Monday; metric lists will be a second release phase.
action_items: [me] will adjust reach and totals over the weekend and potentially perform remapping.
The team needs to provide mapping for locations in Gabon, as it is currently difficult to map them without assistance.
